title: Fever / Acute Febrile Illness
summary: Assess duration, temperature, hydration, localising symptoms and red flags before selecting symptomatic or antimicrobial therapy.
caution: Do not treat fever alone as proof of bacterial infection; choose antimicrobials only when clinically indicated.

title: Cough / Cold / Upper Respiratory Symptoms
summary: Assess duration, breathing difficulty, wheeze, SpO₂, chest findings and red flags.
caution: Urgent assessment is needed for respiratory distress, cyanosis or significant hypoxia.

title: Nausea / Vomiting
summary: Assess hydration, frequency, abdominal pain, blood/bile, pregnancy where relevant and possible acute abdomen.
caution: Persistent vomiting, severe dehydration, altered sensorium, blood or severe abdominal pain needs further assessment/referral.

title: Acidity / Gas / Dyspepsia
summary: Review meal relation, reflux symptoms, medication triggers and alarm features before symptomatic therapy.
caution: GI bleeding, persistent vomiting, severe pain or other alarm features require further investigation.

title: Constipation
summary: Assess duration, stool pattern, hydration, diet and medicines; exclude obstruction/acute abdomen when suggested by symptoms.
caution: Severe abdominal pain, vomiting, distension or inability to pass stool/gas needs urgent assessment.

title: Musculoskeletal Pain / Spasm
summary: Assess site, injury mechanism, neurological symptoms, functional limitation and red flags before selecting analgesic or topical therapy.
caution: Progressive neurological deficit, major trauma, fever with severe pain or other red flags warrants further assessment.

title: Skin / Minor Wound
summary: Clean and assess wound depth, contamination, bleeding, infection signs and tetanus status where relevant.
caution: Deep wounds, uncontrolled bleeding, bites or significant infection may require referral.

title: Eye / Ear Symptoms
summary: Examine the affected site and avoid steroid-containing topical therapy when diagnosis is uncertain or viral/fungal disease is suspected.
checks: Tympanic membrane status for ear drops
caution: Severe eye pain, vision loss, chemical injury or significant trauma requires urgent specialist assessment.

title: Women's Health / Pregnancy
summary: Confirm pregnancy status/gestational age where relevant and assess bleeding, pain, discharge and obstetric red flags.
caution: Pregnancy-related bleeding, severe pain, syncope or hemodynamic instability requires urgent assessment.

title: Paediatric Fever / Pain
summary: Use weight-based dosing references and verify the exact formulation strength; avoid guessing doses for fixed-dose combinations.
caution: Young children with concerning appearance, severe dehydration, respiratory distress, seizure or altered sensorium require urgent assessment.

title: Anaemia / Iron-Folate Supplementation
summary: Interpret haemoglobin and clinical context before selecting iron/folate supplementation; investigate significant or unexplained anaemia.
caution: Severe symptomatic anaemia or ongoing significant bleeding may need urgent evaluation.
